text:
Maya: kicking off kubeadm eu-west-2 cluster bring-up for private inference. Goals: 2 GPU nodepools (a100-80g x4, t4-burst x8), MetalLB FIP for model endpoints, CA/MTU validation, autoscaler + burst. Running preflight now.

Oliver: thanks - please run the quick preflight:
```
./scripts/preflight.sh --region eu-west-2 --check-quotas --check-cni
```
Post output here.

Maya: preflight output:
```
HOST: ok
KERNEL: ip_vs: missing -> WARN
CNI: calico v3.25 detected -> ok
GPU_QUOTA: requested 12, available 8 -> WARN
METALLB: not installed -> INFO
```
Need to open quota ticket, seeing only 8 gpus available.

Kai: opened ticket with cloud: https://support.cloud/tickets/INC-7421 (requested +8 A100s). ETA 48h. For short-term we can scale t4 pool.

Sanjay: recommend taints on A100 pool so only heavy models schedule there, example:
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: Node
metadata:
  labels:
    node.kubernetes.io/accelerator: a100
spec:
  taints:
  - key: gpu-type
    value: a100
    effect: NoSchedule
```
Also set cluster-autoscaler with --balance-similar-node-groups and scale-down-delay.

deploy-bot: kubeadm init started on control-plane-0 (job 8792)

Maya: hit a kube-proxy/ipvs issue, kernel module missing. Ran:
```
modprobe ip_vs
sysctl net.bridge.bridge-nf-call-iptables=1
```
After that kube-proxy came up in ipvs mode.

Oliver: confirm MTU on host NICs is 1500 for eu-west infra. Packet loss if mismatched; set IPPool in calico to 1500 if host mtu is 1500.

Maya: checked MTU, NIC is 1500. Calico IPPool set to 1500. metallb deployed with layer2 address pool and assigned FIP to kube-system/ingress-lb service.

Maya: smoke test for model endpoint:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" http://203.0.113.54/v1/predict -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```
Response: 200 OK, {"output":"stub"}

Sanjay: cost note: a100 pool x4 ~ $X/hr -> ~ $Y/month (on reserved). t4-burst x8 -> cheaper, use for scale bursts. Will add to infra-costs sheet.

Kai: need handoff doc + oncall rotation. @oliver can you own week-1 oncall? Also confirm that metallb FIP is in our ipam range.

Oliver: I can take week-1 oncall. metallb range is 203.0.113.48-203.0.113.63, tagged in netplan. Added to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eu-west-2/kubeadm-first-boot

Maya: updated the runbook with the exact commands, kubeadm token, and next-step checklist. Closing this thread — will follow up if quota arrives and we scale A100 pool. :thumbsup:
